description: The app watch's facts (4.6): apps.seen.<name> (v1.4) and apps.running.<name> (v1.7), published by hideout.appwatch for the apps manifests ask about. Each row: a fact key, a value, and whether a reader accepts it.

vectors.note: Watched, and no process example-app.exe runs: the app isn't open.
Not set: no app watch, or nobody asks about the app (unknown, not 'closed').
The app has run on this PC; kept across restarts.
apps.seen is true or not set.
One label: the exe name without .exe.
The app watch has only apps.seen and apps.running.
